approach: Static ahead-of-time translation of the retail ARM/Thumb binary to native C++, held strict fully-static (zero interpreter fallback) by a self-healing coverage loop
notes: Full playthrough on Windows, Linux and Android — menus, battles, event scripts, cartridge saves and save states; validated widescreen view, fast-forward, keyboard/controller/touch input.
